maria: FYI trying to onboard sherpa-13b (ONNX) to Triton on CI — failing during model load. Can someone confirm weights + tokenizer location? :eyes:

aj: weights + tokenizer? I can grab them if you paste the path. is this the v1 export?

maria: yes v1 ONNX export. weights are in S3: s3://redwood-models/sherpa/13b/onnx/v1/weights.tar.gz. tokenizer files in the same folder: tokenizer.model and tokenizer_config.json. note: export used sentencepiece not byte-bpe.

dave: looking. quick heads-up: Triton ONNX backend on our CUDA12.3 images was built against cuBLAS 12.1 ABI. CI log shows cuBLAS version mismatch at runtime — likely why loader fails. we either rebuild Triton/ORT or use a matching driver image.

ci-bot: build-log snippet:

```
E TritonModelLoader: Failed to initialize CUDA backend: CUBLAS_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED
E runtime: cuBLAS version mismatch: found 12.3, expected 12.1
E ONNXRuntime: Provider failed to initialize
```

sam: re: image — our standard base is `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:22.12-py3` which maps to CUDA12.1. For 12.3 we need a newer base (e.g., `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:23.08`). That requires glibc bump in our container and a quick CI image rebuild.

aj: can we fallback to CPU/ORT while infra patches the GPU image? latency will tank but gives a stopgap.

maria: yes we can serve CPU ORT for canary. create a config that uses `instance_group { kind: KIND_CPU }` for canary route. but we prefer to get GPU support live. need infra to queue rebuild and eng-runtime to validate kernel selection.

dave: also discovered tokenizer mismatch in the export — sentencepiece model uses <s> as BOS id 1 but our prompt pipeline expects BOS=50256. quick fix in preprocess layer to remap token ids for decoding stage. small patch below: 

```
# patch: remap sentencepiece special ids -> model expected ids
def remap_special_ids(tokens):
    # incoming tokens use sp_bos=1, sp_eos=2
    mapping = {1:50256, 2:50257}
    return [mapping.get(t, t) for t in tokens]
```

aj: will that be enough for generation tests? we should add an eval prompt to catch detokenization issues.

maria: agree. add a tiny eval set (3 prompts) and run locally + CI. if detok looks good, we can push canary.

ops-jenkins: queued image rebuild job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/rebuild-triton-12-3/452
Estimated ~25m. tagging @eng-runtime @eng-infra. logs will appear in the job link.

dave: once image is built i'll run a quick kernel probe and try loading ONNX with Triton + ORT. will report back here.

maria: thanks. priority: 1) infra rebuild CUDA12.3 image 2) eng-runtime validate Triton/ORT provider 3) apply token-id remap + add eval prompts 4) canary CPU fallback until GPU is green.

aj: pinging @sam for the glibc bump notes (we'll need to ensure musl-based toolchain isn't sneaking in). :thumbsup:

sam: noted, will coordinate.

ci-bot: CI started for evals (canary-cpu) — job 7789. keeps thread updated.

maria: great. please update this thread when you have kernel probe results or the rebuild finishes. closing loop here after the canary passes. :lock:

ops-jenkins: rebuild finished: success. image digest sha256:abc123. queued for rollout to staging.

dave: loaded ONNX in new image, provider initializes, quick generate works. will run the regression suite now.

maria: awesome — thanks everyone.
